t: Here at the northern end of Queen's Gate in Kensington stands a Grade II listed equestrian statue of Field Marshal Robert Napier, Lord Napier of Magdala. Napier was a British Indian Army officer who fought in the Sikh wars, served at the relief of Lucknow, and took part in the entry to Peking in 1860. He led the expedition to Abyssinia in 1867, defeating Emperor Tewodros with minimal loss of life among his own forces. The sculptor was Joseph Edgar Boehm, who exhibited 123 works at the Royal Academy.
